description: '''Epic collage''' is a [[subgenre]] of [[sound collage]] that emerged in the early 2010s within [[experimental music|experimental]] [[electronic music|electronic]] and [[post-Internet (music)|post-Internet music]]. The term was originally coined by journalist Adam Harper to describe the work of artists such as [[Elysia Crampton]] (as E+E), Total Freedom and [[Chino Amobi]] (as Diamond Hearted Black Boy). Drawing primarily on [[deconstructed club]] and [[electronic dance music]], epic collage combines the [[sampling (music)|sampling]] of [[pop music]] and other recorded media with electronic elements, noise and sound effects.
